component.name: TagMender
component.summary: Identify, tag and organise music with MusicBrainz and Discogs

description.p: TagMender identifies albums and single tracks with MusicBrainz and Discogs as equal sources, previews every change, writes tags with the MusicBrainz tag mapping, so files read the same in other taggers and players, and organises files with journaled operations that can be undone.

Each album is marked with how sure the identification is: the exact release, the album only (its pressings tie), Partial (what every pressing shares) or Unresolved. Free official services are asked first; a web search is off unless you set one up.

ul.li: An inspector with the original and new tags, artwork and the evidence
Search, other versions and a pressing chooser; match files to tracks by hand
Naming and tagging scripts in the tagging script language, with a script editor
Look up a CD, the musicbrainz.org tagger buttons, a player
Your MusicBrainz collections and ratings, and AcoustID submissions, with your own login
Watched folders that tag and file what is dropped into them

description.p: You bring your own keys (a Discogs token, an AcoustID key, ...); nothing is bundled.
